title: Thankfulness
summary: THANK'FULNESS, noun Expression of gratitude; acknowledgment of a favor. 1. Gratitude; a lively sense of good received. The celebration of these holy mysteries being ended, retire with all thankfulness

inlines.v: THANK'FULNESS, noun Expression of gratitude; acknowledgment of a favor. 1. Gratitude; a lively sense of good received. The celebration of these holy mysteries being ended, retire with all thankfulness of heart for having been admitted to that heavenly feast.
